# LLM Instructions for @ecopages/scripts-injector

This file provides model-oriented guidance for generating correct code with this package.

## Package Purpose

`@ecopages/scripts-injector` lazy-loads client scripts based on runtime conditions:
- idle (`on:idle`)
- interaction (`on:interaction`)
- visibility (`on:visible`)

It supports two modes:
1. Web Component mode with `<scripts-injector>`
2. Global mode with `initGlobalInjector()` and `data-eco-trigger`

## Installation

```bash
bun add @ecopages/scripts-injector
```

## Canonical Imports

```ts
import '@ecopages/scripts-injector';
import { initGlobalInjector } from '@ecopages/scripts-injector/global';
```

Use `@ecopages/scripts-injector/global` for global trigger-map mode only.

## Web Component Mode (Preferred for local component-scoped behavior)

Use the custom element name exactly as:

```html
<scripts-injector></scripts-injector>
```

### Valid attributes
- `scripts`: comma-separated URLs
- `on:idle`
- `on:interaction="event1,event2"`
- `on:visible` or `on:visible="<rootMargin>"`

### Example

```html
<scripts-injector scripts="/_assets/heavy-ui.js" on:interaction="mouseenter,focusin">
  <button>Open</button>
</scripts-injector>
```

## Global Mode (Preferred for no-wrapper DOM)

1. Add one or more trigger maps:

```html
<script type="ecopages/global-injector-map">
{
  "analytics-trigger": {
    "on:idle": { "scripts": ["/_assets/tracker.js"] }
  },
  "card-trigger": {
    "on:interaction": {
      "value": "click",
      "scripts": ["/_assets/card.js"]
    }
  }
}
</script>
```

2. Attach triggers to plain elements:

```html
<div data-eco-trigger="analytics-trigger"></div>
<button data-eco-trigger="card-trigger">Open Card</button>
```

3. Initialize once and keep the handle:

```ts
const injector = initGlobalInjector();
```

4. On SPA route/page swaps, call:

```ts
injector.refresh();
```

5. On teardown, call:

```ts
injector.cleanup();
```

## Runtime Guarantees to Preserve in Generated Code

- Do not rename the element to `<script-injector>`; correct tag is `<scripts-injector>`.
- Reuse script URLs; duplicate script injection is prevented.
- Keep `data-eco-trigger` values aligned with keys in `ecopages/global-injector-map`.
- Do not hardcode framework-specific events for global mode; call `refresh()` from framework lifecycle hooks instead.

## Events and Attributes

The package dispatches a `data-loaded` custom event (`ScriptInjectorEvents.DATA_LOADED`) with detail:
- `loadedScripts: string[]`
- `failedScripts: string[]`

Elements may receive:
- `data-loaded`
- `data-load-reason` (`idle`, `visible`, or `interaction:<event>`)
- `data-loaded-scripts`
- `data-error` (comma-separated failed URLs, when failures occur)

## Common Mistakes to Avoid

- Using outdated global API patterns that rely on framework-specific events.
- Calling `injector.cleanup()` immediately after initialization in examples.
- Omitting `scripts` or passing non-string values in markup attributes.
- Forgetting commas in `on:interaction` event lists.

## Minimal Correct Snippets

### Idle load

```html
<scripts-injector scripts="/_assets/analytics.js" on:idle></scripts-injector>
```

### Interaction load

```html
<scripts-injector scripts="/_assets/dialog.js" on:interaction="click,mouseenter">
  <button>Open Dialog</button>
</scripts-injector>
```

### Global refresh integration (pseudo-framework)

```ts
const injector = initGlobalInjector();
router.onAfterNavigate(() => injector.refresh());
```
